title: A CODE pointer cannot name an extensionless script such as src/adr-new
goal: code_pointer returns (path, symbol) for a CODE tag whose path is an extensionless script (a shell script in a repository's src directory), so lint.py stops reporting a CODE tag without a path#symbol pointer for it, or the kb contract names the limit

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import kbfacts; p = kbfacts.tags_in('- x [CODE S1: src/adr-new#newid]'); sys.exit(0 if kbfacts.code_pointer(p[0]) else 1)
